contract:
Issue #3 Done when: the four kinds of key moment are detected with automated tests for each (opponent leaves the London/KID repertoire line; player move loses >= 150 cp vs best (blunder); player misses a winning move (>= 150 cp available, not played); opponent blunders and the player can punish it); ordinary moves produce no key moment (tested); thresholds come from config/tutor.json, not hard-coded; tests pass in CI.

=== The implementation brief the spoke worked from (verbatim contract section) ===
## Base state (measured at 05c2776)
- packages/chess-core exists as a skeleton: package.json (name @chess-tutor/chess-core, type module, exports "." -> ./src/index.ts, script typecheck = tsc --noEmit, dependency chess.js ^1.4.0, installed version 1.4.0), tsconfig.json extends ../../tsconfig.base.json and includes src and test, src/index.ts is a placeholder `export {};` that you replace.
- Root vitest.config.ts includes packages/*/test/**/*.test.ts. Root `pnpm test`: 4 files, 28 tests passed. `pnpm typecheck` clean (runs pnpm -r typecheck).
- tsconfig.base.json: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax, erasableSyntaxOnly (no enums, no parameter properties, no namespaces), allowImportingTsExtensions, module NodeNext. Node 22 type stripping: relative imports carry the .ts extension.
- Do NOT add a dependency on @chess-tutor/engine. Define structurally identical analysis types in chess-core (below) so engine output can be passed in without a package link.

## Engine output shape (copied verbatim from packages/engine/src/types.ts; define the same shapes in chess-core)
```ts
/** An engine score, always from White's point of view. */
export type Score =
  | { kind: "cp"; value: number } // centipawns: +100 means White is about a pawn ahead
  | { kind: "mate"; value: number }; // mate in N moves: positive means White mates, negative means Black mates
export interface AnalysisLine { rank: number; moves: string[]; score: Score; depth: number } // moves in UCI, rank 1-based
export interface Analysis { fen: string; depth: number; lines: AnalysisLine[]; bestMove: string; timeMs: number } // best line first
```
The AnalysisEngine runs multi-PV 3 at depth 18 on every position.

## KeyMoment union (docs/architecture.md §3.4, verbatim; keep these field names)
```ts
type KeyMoment =
  | { kind: "opponent_left_book"; line: string; expected: string[]; played: string }
  | { kind: "player_blunder"; played: string; cpLoss: number; best: string }
  | { kind: "missed_win"; played: string; best: string; gainCp: number }
  | { kind: "punish_opponent"; opponentMove: string; refutation: string; gainCp: number };
detect(input: DetectorInput): KeyMoment | null
```
All move strings in a KeyMoment are SAN (e.g. "Nxe5"), converted with chess.js from the relevant position. line is the repertoire line's name.

## DetectorInput (coordinator's design; you may add optional fields, report any change in contract_gaps)
```ts
interface KeyMomentThresholds { blunderCp: number; missedWinCp: number; punishCp: number }
interface DetectorInput {
  playerColor: "w" | "b";
  fenBefore: string;        // position before the move; its side to move is the mover
  move: string;             // the move just played, UCI (e.g. "e2e4", "e7e8q")
  history: string[];        // UCI moves from the standard start position up to but NOT including move
  before: Analysis;         // analysis of fenBefore
  after: Analysis;          // analysis of the position after move
  repertoire: Repertoire | null;
  thresholds: KeyMomentThresholds;
}
```
The mover is the side to move in fenBefore; mover === playerColor means a player move, otherwise an opponent move.

## Evaluation rules (decide exactly these; tests pin each boundary)
- Convert a Score to centipawns from a given side's point of view: cp -> value (negated for Black); mate N -> sign * (100000 - 100*|N|) from White's view, then negated for Black. Mate 0 / checkmate positions: handle when after.lines is empty (game over): if the mover just delivered mate treat played eval as +100000 for the mover; stalemate = 0.
- bestEval = before.lines[0].score, from the mover's view. playedEval = after.lines[0].score, from the mover's view (after's side to move is the other side, but Score is White-relative so just convert for the mover). loss = bestEval - playedEval, floored at 0. If before.lines is empty, return null.
- Player move (mover === playerColor):
  - missed_win if bestEval >= missedWinCp AND playedEval >= 0 AND loss >= missedWinCp. gainCp = loss. best = SAN of before.bestMove in fenBefore.
  - otherwise player_blunder if loss >= blunderCp. cpLoss = loss. best as above.
  - otherwise null. (The player leaving their own book is not a key moment.)
- Opponent move (mover !== playerColor), in this precedence:
  1. punish_opponent if loss >= punishCp (loss computed from the opponent's view). opponentMove = SAN of move; refutation = SAN of after.bestMove in the after position; gainCp = loss.
  2. opponent_left_book if repertoire is non-null, history (before this move) is inside some repertoire line for playerColor, and move is not one of the repertoire continuations at that point. expected = continuation SANs, played = SAN of move, line = the name of the (first) line that matched history.
  3. otherwise null.
- A move that is not legal in fenBefore: throw an Error (caller bug), do not return null.

## Repertoire
```ts
interface RepertoireLineInput { name: string; color: "w" | "b"; pgn: string } // pgn = mainline movetext only, e.g. "1. d4 d5 2. Bf4 Nf6 3. e3"
class or factory: buildRepertoire(lines: RepertoireLineInput[]): Repertoire
interface Repertoire {
  /** Continuations after history (UCI from start) for lines of this color, or null when history has left every line. Empty array when history is at the end of a line. */
  continuations(history: string[], color: "w" | "b"): { line: string; moves: { uci: string; san: string }[] } | null;
}
```
Parse PGN with chess.js. Several lines may share a prefix (e.g. London vs ...d5 and London vs ...g6); continuations merges them (unique moves). Only "in book" when history is a prefix of at least one line. Leaving the book at the end of a line (history equals a full line) is NOT opponent_left_book: no expected moves means no deviation.
The real London/KID files in repertoire/ are decided by the user on issue #13 and are out of scope; use small fixture lines in test/.

## Config (config/tutor.json, measured)
"keyMoments": { "blunderCp": 150, "missedWinCp": 150, "punishCp": 150 }. Tests may read this file to pass the real defaults; src must not read files.

=== Choices the spoke reported (judge them) ===
- Opponent stalemates/ends the game while losing (after.lines empty, loss >= punishCp): no refutation, so punish_opponent is skipped and opponent_left_book runs next.
- after.lines empty but not game over: returns null.
- Legality is checked before before.lines emptiness, so an illegal move throws even with empty before.lines.
- Mate 0: scoreToCp takes optional sideToMove so mate 0 is -100000 for the side to move.
- Extra exports: scoreToCp, MATE_CP, sanOf, types Color and Continuations.
